item.title: This is what Minority said about Fourth Estate's Big Push sole-source scandal
item.description: The Minority in Parliament has urged the government to publish full details of 81 Big Push road contracts worth over GHS73 billion, following a Fourth Estate exposé.

item.title: Barcelona need to cough up €80 million to sign summer target for Hansi Flick
item.description: Barcelona targets Julian Alvarez as Robert Lewandowski’s successor, with intense negotiations required due to Atletico Madrid's strong stance and €80m valuation.

item.title: Karma President drops scary doom prophecy about Kumawood actress Kyeiwaa
item.description: Karma President has stirred controversy with a prophecy for Kumawood actress Kyeiwaa, warning of impending doom in a recent TikTok video. Response awaited.

item.title: “I took two of them away”: Father of Weija-Gbawe children tells Minister
item.description: The father of the children rescued from their mother in the Weija-Gbawe municipality has been identified following efforts by concerned residents.

item.title: Valerie Perrine, Superman actress, dies at 82 after Parkinson's battle
item.description: Valerie Perrine, beloved for her role in Superman, has died at 82 after a long battle with Parkinson's Disease, leaving a legacy of resilience and talent behind.

item.title: Wode Maya sparks fear over health, shares visit to dialysis center
item.description: Ghanaian YouTuber Wode Maya has sounded the alarm over several young men on dialysis linked to aphrodisiac misuse, urging caution over the health risks.

item.title: Man returns from abroad, cries out as money sent to build house is misused
item.description: A young Ghanaian who was hoping to come home to a plush mansion has been left heartbroken after uncovering what he came to meet on his return from the UAE

item.title: Car dealer shares major reasons why you must buy a car before a house
item.description: Female car dealer Tripz Autoz argued that perception shapes success in business, prioritising car ownership over property investment in building one's image.

item.title: "What happened to her": Joyce Mensah's current state after hiatus raises concern
item.description: Former HIV/AIDS ambassador Joyce Dzidzor Mensah resurfaced on social media, sharing cryptic posts about life challenges and raising concerns among Ghanaians.

item.title: Roads Minister reacts to Fourth Estate's Big Push sole-sourced contracts exposé
item.description: Governs Kwame Agbodza, the Minister for Roads and Highways has defended the awarding of 81 contracts under the Big Push road projects amid the Fourth Estate exposé.
